forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 43 of October, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 2 zone surveys and 1 visit; no technical surveys or clearances were completed. NAR-Z04 was declared free this week.

Officer attention: 9 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No reports or dossiers were held, and no new plan was approved; work remains under P10.

The forecast, made in week 40 for the zones of its plan and counting what was already done, gives a range of 12 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 11 zones declared free.
